official_documents.finding: Market and books API documented for Ethereum chain 1. Examples are illustrative; no real book snapshots acquired.

Signed offchain maker offers supply book levels; historical receipts alone cannot demonstrate ex-ante takeability.
Conditional builder ETH advance for underfunded signed Ethereum bundles when builder ends net positive; no exact NQC financing admission.
CDP paymaster developer-billing risk remains on Base, non-recourse for NQC not proven.
